thread:
sara_sales: FinBank EU POC tomorrow—they need EU-only handling for trial. Questions: guarantee egress+inference in EU? full EU subproc list? what if region capacity exhausted, will we route non-EU? need quick cost delta for pinning vs hosted fallback. need by EOD.

raj_solutions: TL;DR: we can pin tenant to EU (tenant_pin), share redacted EU subproc list after NDA/DPA, and offer Dedicated if they require strict SLA/no-failover. Pinning = +15% per-token surcharge for POC, Dedicated = commit pricing.

infra_engr: Two routing modes: tenant_affinity (soft) and tenant_pin (hard). tenant_pin prevents automatic cross-region failover; fallback only manual.

infra_engr: Sample config to show customer:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  mode: tenant_pin # tenant_affinity | tenant_pin
  preferred_regions: [eu-west-1, eu-central-1]
  fallback: manual_review # automatic | manual_review
```

ops_oncall: Note: regional autoscale limits can cause queuing if pinned. We can enable graceful degradation: enforced batching or token caps.

legal_qa: I'll prepare a redacted EU subproc list and attach to ticket; full vendor contacts require DPA + NDA.

deploy_bot: Created INF-7123: "POC FinBank EU - pinning + subproc attestation" -> https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/INF-7123

raj_solutions: I'll draft a 1-pager: routing options, fail modes, & quick pricing (hosted-pinned vs dedicated vs private). sending within 2h.

sara_sales: Awesome, please add the redacted list to the ticket and paste the 1-pager here. Thanks :thumbsup:
